title: AMD's Ryzen Processors Garner Attention in Italy
description: AMD's Ryzen processors are trending in Italy, with news highlighting the company's latest EPYC 9006 Venice and Zen 7 CPUs.

sections.heading: AMD EPYC 9006 Venice
paragraphs: Phoronix reports that AMD has announced its EPYC 9006 Venice processor, which is expected to perform exceptionally well.

sections.heading: Super Micro Computer's Growth
paragraphs: According to Simply Wall Street, Super Micro Computer's stock has risen by 26.3% following significant AI orders and the launch of their new H15 platform.

sections.heading: AMD Zen 7 and Future of AM5 Motherboards
paragraphs: Club386 suggests that AMD's upcoming Zen 7 Ryzen CPUs are likely to be the last ones compatible with AM5 motherboards.
